Prizd/Privacy

Privacy

Prizd is a free index of hackathons, case competitions and internships. We keep as little about you as we can, and only what a feature needs.

What we collect

  • If you sign in with Google: your name, email address and profile picture, and the opportunities you save.
  • If you leave an email: your email address and the topics you ticked (hackathons, internships, case comps).
  • If you add a WhatsApp number: that number, only for deadline alerts you asked for.
  • When you agree: the time you agreed and the page you agreed on, so we can show your consent was given.
  • If you arrive through a friend's invite link, we note the invite code.

Why

  • To keep your shortlist across devices and unlock filters.
  • To send the weekly digest and deadline reminders you opted into. We never send anything else, and we never sell or rent your data.

Who handles it

Google confirms your identity. Supabase stores the data. Resend delivers email. Each acts only on our instructions to run the service.

Your choices

  • Every email has an unsubscribe link, and it works at once.
  • Email signups are double opt-in: nothing is sent until you tap the link in the confirmation email.
  • Signed-in users can change preferences or delete their account and data from the Account panel at any time.

You can unsubscribe from any email with its unsubscribe link, and delete your account and data yourself from the Account panel.
